tool.name: CompareLandcoverModels

param.name: model_files
param.dialogReference: Select two or more trained model files (.joblib) to compare. These should be models trained on the same dataset with the same class structure. The tool will extract performance metrics from each model and generate comparative analyses. Use Ctrl+Click to select multiple files.

param.name: output_folder
param.dialogReference:
Folder where comparison results will be saved. The tool creates subfolders for reports and figures, including:

  • Comparison table (CSV and Excel formats)

  • Performance comparison charts

  • Feature importance plots

  • Detailed comparison report

tool.summary:
Evaluate and Compare Performance Metrics of Multiple Trained Models

This tool allows you to load several trained models and assess their performance using accuracy metrics recorded during training. It generates comparison tables, charts, and analyses of feature importance to help you identify the best model for your classification task.

Outputs include:

  • A comparison table featuring all performance metrics

  • Bar charts illustrating model performance

  • A comparison of feature importance across models

  • Reports in Excel and CSV formats
tool.usage:
Use this tool to:

  • Compare different algorithms (Random Forest vs XGBoost vs others)

  • Compare the same algorithm with different settings

  • Evaluate which features are most important across models

  • Make informed decisions about which model to use for final classification

Select 2 or more trained model files for meaningful comparison.
